title: Worker management controlplane command infrastructure
intended_behavior: Operators publish signed Nostr command events for worker cordon, uncordon, drain, undrain, maintenance enter, maintenance exit, and labels update.
Worker command events carry worker pubkey, reason, operator metadata, and idempotency key/correlation tags.

The controlplane reactor validates authorized worker commands, applies scheduling state or label changes through the worker repository, emits worker status/result events, and publishes a replaceable worker state read model.
The reactor subscribes to and dispatches all worker command kinds through the same event-driven command/result/read-model pattern as existing controlplane domains.
observed_baseline: Worker domain/repository fields for scheduling state, scheduling note, labels, and capabilities already existed before Bucket C.
No worker-specific controlplane command publisher, handlers, request kinds, result kinds, or worker state read model kind existed before Bucket C.
out_of_scope: Scheduling enforcement in worker_policy.go and ml_placement.go.
MCP worker tools and assignment/drain read models scheduled for later beads.
